summary: A symmetrical, single-story structure with a T-shaped footprint, featuring a flat brick roof and a central glass-walled observation tower. The exterior walls are constructed of yellowish bricks accented with white horizontal bands and vertical protruding pillars. A spaced white block perimeter surrounds the building on a dirt foundation.

shape.overall_form: T-shaped base with a central tower

materials.name: stonebrick
materials.role: main exterior walls (appears as yellowish end stone bricks)

materials.name: quartz
materials.role: accents, pillars, horizontal bands, and perimeter wall

materials.name: brick
materials.role: main flat roof surface and tower roof tiers

materials.name: slab_stone
materials.role: roof borders, cornices, and tower roof edges

rebuild_hints: Lay out a T-shaped footprint for the main building, with the top of the 'T' forming the main body and the stem forming the entrance.
Construct the walls using the yellowish brick, inserting a horizontal white band halfway up the wall height.
Add vertical white pillars that protrude one block outward from the main walls at regular intervals and corners.
Fill the flat roof area with brick blocks and edge the entire roofline with stone slabs.
Build the central tower on the main roof using glass blocks or panes for the walls, topping it with a tiered brick and stone slab roof.
Create a perimeter boundary using single white blocks spaced exactly one block apart, following the shape of the building.
uncertainties: Interior layout, flooring, and lighting are completely hidden from view.
Exact material IDs for the yellowish walls (likely end stone bricks or sandstone) and the white blocks (quartz, smooth quartz, or white concrete).
